Default: RGB(0,0,0) 1: Nozzle size color identifier2: Nozzle type color identifier(Each Nozzle family is of a certain type (like 7xx or 8xx) plus a certain material (72x, 73x). member.name: T:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.Panel
member.summary: A Panel object represents 1) a portion of a printed circuit board, which is either a logical division of one board or 2) one of several smaller boards made from one board.Panels belong to a board side or another panel. and lt;p and gt;Panels are alway encapsulated into a PanelMatrix object. This object is meant to facilitate board designs where several small, identical boards are produced on the same physical board. For situations where the board only contains one Panel, it must still be encapsulated in a PanelMatrix (with dimensions of 1 row and 1 column). Note: Panels in a PanelMatrix cannot be oriented individually because all panels in a PanelMatrix share the same angle of rotation and coordinate system orientation values. and lt;p and gt; and lt;p and gt;Unlike a board, a panel may assume a polygonal shape. The PolygonPoints object property stores coordinates that dictate width and length dimensions as well as the shape of a Panel object. Panel dimensions can exceed Board dimensions. and lt;/p and gt; and lt;p and gt;Panels may be associated with different placement lists or multiple instances of the same placement list even though they exist on the same board. and lt;/p and gt;
Overloaded Constructor to pass in initialize values. Pass in null for the Nullable parameters to use the default value.
member.param: Changes an object's color in SIPLACE Pro Desk. (RGB)
Coordinate system, distinguishes an object's particular type of coordinate system (e.g., how the bottomside of a Board is mirrored).

Offset X (mm) vector from object's origin to zero point of its current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointX Offset is the vector from that origin to the x coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve).

Offset Y (mm) vector from object's origin to 0 point of current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointY Offset is the vector from that origin to the X coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve).
Height of specified object in mm's. Ranges for Board/Panel are Default: 1.5 Min: 0.0 Max: 5.0

If a user overlays a bitmap on a board in order to position components on the board, the board side needs to be transparent; otherwise, the bitmap would be obscured. True if the board side is Transparent. Default = true.
The level of transparency. Is evaluated if Transparent property is set to true.
Determines the position correction method the station will use to correct the component positions while placing.
Determines if the panel itself represents a PCB. It indicates, which panels are counted in the trace data.
Panel angle (internally saved in radians), as expressed in radians for offset purposes. Default: 0.0
Offset X vector relative to the parent object in mm's. The x direction is parallel to the direction the board moves through the printer/placement machine.Default: 0.0 mm.
Offset Y vector relative to the parent object in mm's. The Y direction is perpendicular to the direction the board moves through the printer/placement machine.Default: 0.0 mm.

A Placement list contains all the necessary component placement data to place components on a board (via board sides and panels). Use this type of link to maintain a live connection to a placement list.

This object is meant to facilitate board designs where several small, identical boards are produced on the same physical board. For situations where the board only contains one Panel, it must still be encapsulated in a PanelMatrix (with dimensions of 1 row and 1 column). Panel dimensions can exceed Board dimensions.Panels may be associated with different placement lists or multiple instances of the same placement list even though they exist on the same board.

member.name: T:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.PanelMatrix
member.summary: PanelMatrix objects represent arrays of Panels arranged in a regular matrix. Contrary to the visual suggestion that a PanelMatrix contains multiple panels, PanelMatrix objects simply replicate identical copies of a single Panel across the surface of a board. For example: each Panel in the PanelMatrix represents one of several (identical) smaller boards made from one board.Panels within a PanelMatrix must be identical and cannot be rotated or oriented individually. Rotating or changing the coordinate system of a Panel in a Panel Marix wil affect all Panels in the PanelMatrix.

member.param: Offset X vector from object's origin to zero point of its current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointX Offset is the vector from that origin to the x coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for IBoardside, IPanel, IReceptacle, and ITrayReserveType only (mm's). IBoardside IPanel IReceptacle ITrayReserveTypeMax 508.0 508.0 999.999 999.999Min -508.0 -508.0 -999.999 -999.999Default 0.0 0.0 0.0 0.0Refer to online help for more extensive offset information.

This property is user-defined for IBoardside, IPanel, IReceptacle, and ITrayReserveType only (mm's). member.name: T:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.Recipe
member.summary: CRecipe (Server Obj), a server object that dictates how SIPLACE equipment will produce a single type of printed circuit board after optimization because it links to everything needed to produce a board with a line. A Recipe must be optimized before being downloaded to a station. In a Job containing multiple Recipes, only one Recipe can be used by the Line at one time.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.Recipe.PrinterBoard
member.summary: Reference to the PrinterBoard which is used on one conveyor lane.
member.exception: This property is only fully supported in SIPLACE Pro Version(s) [V18.0 and above] Any attempt to call the set_PrinterBoard will result in an exception otherwise. However, calling get_PrinterBoard will return the default value if applicable without an exception raised. See Session.ThrowErrorOnModelAccessViolations for settings on version behavior.

member.summary: Method : obtain the production time of the recipeFor a Recipe, this method calculates the production time associated with a recipe in the job (e.g., LotSize * RecipeCycleTime).Note: If LotSize = -1, i.e. an infinite number of boards shall be produced, then GetProductionTime() = 0
member.returns: See Summary for details. This method will return a type double with default value of 0.0

member.name: M:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.Recipe.GetPlacementRate
member.summary: Method : obtain the placement rate of the recipeFor a Recipe, this method calculates how many components can be placed per hour (based on the Production Time of each referenced recipe (e.g., GetProductionTime) divided by number of components to be placed for each referenced recipe).Note: If the HeadCycleTime is 0 then the Placement Rate is set to 0. If the Placement Rate is too low, you may want to make adjustments and re-optimize.
member.returns: See Summary for details. This method will return a type double with default value of 0.0

member.summary: (line control needs it to fulfill the interface ILineControl2 to the station).Today's whispering down the line transfers info. such as bad marks on individual circuits from one mchine to the subsequent machine. This means that the info. to be transferred has to come from the previous machine.With the new development such as the bad mark sensor, it is no longer necessary for the 1st placement machine to read all bad marks. The optimizer has to consider where the bad mark information will be read and use that info. for balancing a line.

member.name: T:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.Station
member.summary: Station object (Server Obj), a server object that represents a placement machine, a printer, or an oven positioned in a Line. Use the Station object to configure how boards will be produced on a particular placement machine. The object's two most important properties are IPAddress and SW_Version: While the use of the first property is obvious, the second requires the correct version of software currently on the station computer. Note: The WhisperDownTheLine property is an efficiency measure to ensure that lines with multiple stations hand off a portion of a job to the next station with no duplication of tasks and minimal idle time. This property is available only for placement machines (not ovens or printers).

member.name: T:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.StationLocation
member.summary: Station location object.This object contains links to user-definable options to configure a station (e.g., heads, cameras, nozzle changers, etc.) based on a selected station type. This object complements IStationType, which contains read-only station information.
Overloaded Constructor to pass in initialize values. Pass in null for the Nullable parameters to use the default value.
member.param: Link to an attachable head object. A head is a component-handling mechanism that uses cameras and nozzles. The head 'picks up' components from feeders via its nozzles and then places them on the board. SIPLACE machines have three types of heads: Revolver-6 (with 6 segments), Revolver-12 (with 12 segments), and IC (Pick and Place). Nozzles are assigned to head segments for component processing. Different stations can have different types of heads (which makes them 'attachable'): F4: Rev-12 and IC F5-6: Rev-6, and IC S20/S23/HS50: Rev-12
Stations may possess multiple cameras, but only one IC/Flip Chip camera. Use this property to link to an existing IC/Flip Chip camera object.
Stations may possess multiple cameras, but only one coplanarity camera. Use this property to link to an existing coplanarity camera object.

Links to a component sensor object. A component sensor is one of four types of placement station cameras, developed for 12 nozzle heads, whose main role is to check for the following conditions: for the presence of a component, if the component is of the wrong type or if the correct component is in the wrong position, and to improve the 0201 component pickup rate.The component cameras in the head are not replaced by the component sensor. Instead, component sensor is implemented analogous to the component camera. Both the cameras and the BE sensor work together.The component sensor does not have to be mounted on all portals of the station.
The component camera, which is assembled stationary at the station location.
The component camera, which is assembled at the placement head
Get/Set the table assigned to this station location.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.StationLocation.AttachableHead
member.summary: Link to an attachable head object. A head is a component-handling mechanism that uses cameras and nozzles. The head 'picks up' components from feeders via its nozzles and then places them on the board. SIPLACE machines have three types of heads: Revolver-6 (with 6 segments), Revolver-12 (with 12 segments), and IC (Pick and Place). Nozzles are assigned to head segments for component processing. Different stations can have different types of heads (which makes them 'attachable'): F4: Rev-12 and IC F5-6: Rev-6, and IC S20/S23/HS50: Rev-12

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.StationLocation.FlipChipCamera
member.summary: Stations may possess multiple cameras, but only one IC/Flip Chip camera. Use this property to link to an existing IC/Flip Chip camera object.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.StationLocation.CoplanCamera
member.summary: Stations may possess multiple cameras, but only one coplanarity camera. Use this property to link to an existing coplanarity camera object.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.StationLocation.ComponentSensor
member.summary: Links to a component sensor object. A component sensor is one of four types of placement station cameras, developed for 12 nozzle heads, whose main role is to check for the following conditions: for the presence of a component, if the component is of the wrong type or if the correct component is in the wrong position, and to improve the 0201 component pickup rate.The component cameras in the head are not replaced by the component sensor. Instead, component sensor is implemented analogous to the component camera. Both the cameras and the BE sensor work together.The component sensor does not have to be mounted on all portals of the station.

member.name: T:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.StationSetup
member.summary: Station setup object.At the current time, this object serves as a placeholder from which different station locations can be accessed.
Overloaded Constructor to pass in initialize values. Pass in null for the Nullable parameters to use the default value.
member.param: Reference to the vision object associated to this station location
Coupler containing the current (live) CameraType object

False means that the station is clustered with subsequent stations. Individual stations are always the end of a cluster.Cluster stands for two or more stations that operate logically in parallel. Unlike LCU, SIPLACE Pro only supports homogeneous clusters. The station types and their setups must be identical. 95% of the clusters in the field are currently homogeneous.The last station in the line must have IStationSetup.EndOfCluster = true
Reference to the associated reference object

In case a station is omitted the optimizer won't assign any placement post ion of fiducial measuring to this station, further line control won't take this station into account while download. This mode has to be also enabled on the station software by setting it in the pass through mode.
Switches the heavy board conveyor mode on and off for the station. The mode includes that the buffer conveyors are left empty and the conveyor is operated with less acceleration.
The attribute contains the station software version, which was selected in the station, when the setup was created.
Contains the mode in which way arbitrary setup of components is supported.
Activates the usage of the support pin feature
Controls the distribution of component placements in stations with more than one placement area.
Defines how the pre pick of components is handled at the station
Activates the periodic measurement of fiducials in case the fiducial expiration time is set on a board side.
The attribute contains the selected station topology configuration for this setup.

member.summary: For internal use only. This interface implements TrackArea, a user-defined non-server object, which returns information about the configuration of the portion of a Table where feeders are mounted.Note: To assign feeders to a track, use the LoadFeeder method of the Table object. To remove feeders from a track, use the Table's RemoveFeeder method.
Overloaded Constructor to pass in initialize values. Pass in null for the Nullable parameters to use the default value.
member.param: Where first track feeder will begin (0 for empty).
Last track feeder will occupy (Returns '0' if empty).
Returns 'True' if a feeder is loaded on a track area. Default: False
Link to the IFeeder interface, which enables users to access all feeders.
The dimension Y of an individual track in current track area.
The dimension X of an individual track in this track area.
Specify if the track area is blocked, which means no feeder can be setup.

Overloaded Constructor to pass in initialize values. Pass in null for the Nullable parameters to use the default value.
member.param: Additional carrier offset in X direction
Additional carrier offset in Y direction
Where first track feeder will begin at (0 for empty).

Offset X vector relative to the parent object in mm's. The x direction is parallel to the direction the board moves through the printer/placement machine.
Offset Y vector relative to the parent object in mm's. The Y direction is perpendicular to the direction the board moves through the printer/placement machine.
Offset Z vector relative to the parent object.

For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointX Offset is the vector from that origin to the x coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for IBoardside, IPanel, IReceptacle, and ITrayReserveType only (mm's).

member.name: T:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.TrayReserve
member.summary: Tray reserve object, a user-defined non-server object, which defines physical and functional characteristics of one-level tray feeder trays and waffle pack trays (not matrix tray feeder trays).Note: A reserve is a 'pocket' or area where a component is picked up. A TrayReserve encompasses all receptacles on a tray feeder (and, therefore, can be visualized as the tray itself).
Overloaded Constructor to pass in initialize values. Pass in null for the Nullable parameters to use the default value.
member.param: Identifies type equipment for download purposes. For internal use.
Use TypeRef object property to maintain a connection to a live 'type' object (e.g., IStationType for Station).

Offset X vector relative to the parent object in mm's. The x direction is parallel to the direction the board moves through the printer/placement machine.Default: 0.0 mm. Max/min values vary by object (e.g., IPanel's Max = 480.0 Min = -480.0 whereas IGroup's Max = 100.0 Min = -100.0)

Offset Y vector relative to the parent object in mm's. The Y direction is perpendicular to the direction the board moves through the printer/placement machine.Default: 0.0 mm. Max/min values vary by object (e.g., IPanel's Max = 508.0 Min = -508.0 whereas IGroup's Max = 100.0 Min = -100.0)
True ensures component remains with assigned feeder (and assigned order from left to right in the feeder) after optimization. Default: False.
Wait Time (in ms) until a feeder is ready for a subsequent component to be picked up.

Read only. For feeders, HeadWaitTime is the time (in ms) the Head is waiting for the component to available for pick up. For INozzleChangerType, HeadWaitTime consists of the time the head remains with the nozzle changer while the nozzle change occurs.

member.name: T:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.TrayReserveType
member.summary: Server object of the tray reserve type. A tray reserve type defines physical and functional characteristics of one-level tray feeder trays and waffle pack trays (not matrix tray feeder trays) in addition to those defined by TrayReserve, its parent object.This object is associated with both Tray and MatrixTrayFeeder objects. Since these types of feeders are user-defined (unlike other feeders, such as tape feeders), you should first configure TrayReserve and ComponentShape objects.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.TrayReserveType.OffsetZeroPointX
member.summary: Offset X vector from object's origin to zero point of its current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointX Offset is the vector from that origin to the x coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for IBoardSide, IPanel, IReceptacle, and ITrayReserveType only in [mm]. Refer to online help for more extensive offset information.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.TrayReserveType.OffsetZeroPointY

The ZeroPointY Offset is the vector from that origin to the X coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for IBoardSide, IPanel, IReceptacle, and ITrayReserveType only in [mm]. Refer to online help for more extensive offset information. member.name: T:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.VisionDataManager
member.summary: From V1.4, SIPLACE Pro starts to support Vision Data Management / Blob Management. Each component shape will be taught first on a station, and named station level blob; then if necessary, it could be promoted to line level blob, or system level blob. When downloading a recipe to a station, LCU will first check if a component shape has a corresponding station level blob; if not, it will then check if it has a corresponding line level blob; if still not, it will pick up the system level blob and download it to the station.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.ParameterSetBoardStop.RightFeedDelay
member.summary: Sets a time delay on the operation of the camera board stop to allow for long or irregular shaped boards when fed from the right. The delay is commenced when the camera Board at Stop sensor has seen the trailing edge of the board. After a trailing edge of the board is detected at the board stop sensor, the Right Feed Delay is the time allowed for the board to pass before checking that the board stop sensor again to see that the board is no longer detected - i.e. the trailing edge has passed the board stop sensor and the board is not stuck.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.PlacementProcessParameters.Force
member.summary: Force to place a component on a board. The placement force depends on the following parameters: material and size of the component, nozzle material, and composition (consistency) of the adhesive or solder paste used to place the component.
member.remarks: [DefaultValue(2.0)] [RangeValueAttribute(0.0, 100.0)] In case PlacementForceSetting is set to Standard this property will return 2.0 N. In case PlacementForceSetting is set to VeryLowForce this property will return 0.5 N. In case the special placement process is set to touchless / touchless smt or spring the force will always be 0.0 N

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.PlacementProcessParameters.PlacementForceRaw
member.summary: Force to place a component on a board. The placement force depends on the following parameters: material and size of the component, nozzle material, and composition (consistency) of the adhesive or solder paste used to place the component.
member.remarks: [DefaultValue(2.0)] [RangeValueAttribute(0.5, 100.0)] Does not take the UseStandardForcePickUp into account. And returns the raw force value.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.PrinterBoardSupport.SeparateVacDelay
member.summary: This delay is used when the Print Vacuum Mode is set to Off and Vacuum Sense is set to Disabled. With Print Vacuum Mode set to Off, vacuum tooling is turned off for the duration of the print stroke. It is then turned on again at the end of the print stroke. If Vacuum Sense is set to Enabled, the software will delay for the Vacuum Sensor Delay before checking the vacuum. If the vacuum level is sufficient, then the table will separate. With Vacuum Sense set to Disabled, there is no Vacuum Sense Delay before separation. This means that the vacuum will not have had enough time to build up. The purpose of the Separate Vac Delay is to delay the table from separating to allow time for the vacuum to build up when the Print Vacuum Mode is set to Off and Vacuum Sense is set to Enabled.In V9, this parameter determined the duration of delay with vacuum applied after printing and before the rising table is lowered to Separation Height.This is similar to the Separation Delay, so the behavior of this parameter in V10 has changed as described above.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.PrinterBoardSupport.VacuumDecayDelay
member.summary: This parameter is used to specify a delay period that occurs after soft rail land while the rising table is descending.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.PrinterType.OffsetZeroPointX
member.summary: Offset X vector from object's origin to zero point of its current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointX Offset is the vector from that origin to the x coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for IBoardside, IPanel, IReceptacle, and ITrayReserveType only (mm's).

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.PrinterType.OffsetZeroPointY
member.summary: Offset Y vector from object's origin to 0 point of current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointY Offset is the vector from that origin to the X coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for IBoardside, IPanel, IReceptacle, and ITrayReserveType only (mm's).

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.PrinterType.OffsetZeroPointZ
member.summary: Offset X vector from object's origin to 0 point of current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointZ Offset is the vector from that origin to the Z coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for Receptacle only.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.StencilImageDefinition.DistanceToImage
member.summary: Defines the dimension from the outside rear of the Stencil Frame to the Front EdgeImage of the Board. For a CentreJustified Image,measure from the outside of the rear of the Stencil Frame to the centre line of the Stencil Frame plus half theBoard Width;for an EdgeImage Justified Image, measure from the outside of the rear of the Stencil Frame to the foremost apertureplus the distancefrom the Front EdgeImage of the Board to the foremost aperture. If CustomImage is selected, the Distance To Image value willbe that setby the user in the Distance To Image parameter; if CustomImage is not selected, the Distance To Image value will dependon the particularStencil Frame Size selected and the Stencil Image Justification (EdgeImage or Centre). If the Stencil Image is CentreJustified,then Distance To Image = (Frame Length + Board Width) / 2; if the Stencil Image is EdgeImage Justified, then Distance ToImage = Frame Length - 114mm.Note that an EdgeImage Justified Image is 114mm from the outside of the front of the Stencil Frame.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.StencilImageDefinition.Justification
member.summary: The Stencil Justification typeThis parameter defines the position of the image within the screen frame. The options are: EdgeImage Justified - The board image is situated closer to the front of the screen frame than the rear. Centre Justified - The centre of the board image is centred about the centre line of the screen frame.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.CarrierType.OffsetZeroPointX
member.summary: Offset X vector from object's origin to zero point of its current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointX Offset is the vector from that origin to the x coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for IBoardside, IPanel, IReceptacle, and ITrayReserveType only (mm's).

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.CarrierType.OffsetZeroPointY
member.summary: Offset Y vector from object's origin to 0 point of current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointY Offset is the vector from that origin to the Y coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for IBoardside, IPanel, IReceptacle, and ITrayReserveType only (mm's).

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.CarrierType.OffsetZeroPointZ
member.summary: Offset Z vector from object's origin to 0 point of current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointZ Offset is the vector from that origin to the Z coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for Receptacle only.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.CarrierType.Color
member.summary: Changes an object's color in SIPLACE Pro Desk.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.CarrierType.TrayReferenceCorner
member.summary: Set the reference corner of the tray reserve on the carrier. From this corner the tray offset values are calculated.
member.exception: This property is only fully supported in SIPLACE Pro Version(s) [V7.0 and above] Any attempt to call the set_TrayReferenceCorner will result in an exception otherwise. However, calling get_TrayReferenceCorner will return the default value if applicable without an exception raised. See Session.ThrowErrorOnModelAccessViolations for settings on version behavior.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.CarrierType.StaticHeightRestriction
member.summary: If greater than 0.0 the height of the tray and the component on it is restricted to this value.
member.exception: This property is only fully supported in SIPLACE Pro Version(s) [V11.1 and above] Any attempt to call the set_StaticHeightRestriction will result in an exception otherwise. However, calling get_StaticHeightRestriction will return the default value if applicable without an exception raised. See Session.ThrowErrorOnModelAccessViolations for settings on version behavior.

member.summary: Read only. Time (in seconds) until a head can fetch the next nozzle. A nozzle changer with a SysTypeTime ) 0 cannot be used again by any head until the 'SysTypeTime' has passed. However, the head is free to proceed with its work.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.NozzleChangerType.OffsetZeroPointX
member.summary: Offset X vector from object's origin to 0 point of current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointZ Offset is the vector from that origin to the Z coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for Receptacle only. Refer to online help for more extensive offset information.

member.name: P:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.NozzleChangerType.OffsetZeroPointY
member.summary: Offset Y vector from object's origin to 0 point of current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointY Offset is the vector from that origin to the X coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for IBoardside, IPanel, IReceptacle, and ITrayReserveType only (mm's).

member.summary: Offset X vector from object's origin to zero point of its current position. For example, SIPLACE Pro assigns the center of a waffle pack tray to be its origin for drawing and positioning purposes. The ZeroPointX Offset is the vector from that origin to the x coordinate to the lower-left corner of the actual waffle pack tray (or tray reserve). This property is user-defined for IBoardside, IPanel, IReceptacle, and ITrayReserveType only (mm's).

This property is user-defined for IBoardside, IPanel, IReceptacle, and ITrayReserveType only (mm's).

member.name: T:Asm.As.Oib.SiplacePro.Proxy.Business.Objects.TapeFixedReserve
member.summary: Tape-fixed-reserve object, a non-server object that stores the read-only dimensions of a particular tape fixed reserve (e.g., the designated area or receptacle from which a component is 'picked up'). Note: The 8mms feeder contains two reserves, one describing a tape and one describing the pick-up position. Do not confuse with TapeReserve, a user-created writable object: TapeFeeder links to TapeReserve.
